source.bom_policy: No grouping, no DNP exclusion; include BOM-excluded entries. KiCad suppresses nonphysical power flags. All exported references represented exactly once.

conventions.page_numbering: One-based physical PDF pages, including covers and appendices; not printed page numbers. Remote-only page references remain provisional until local PDF bytes are hashed.
conventions.status: DOWNLOADED means a parseable PDF was obtained, not electrical validation or release. OPEN means a required download, custom specification or manufacturer selection is unresolved. NOT_APPLICABLE is reserved for etched PCB features.
conventions.passive_ratings: For passive components, ratings/derating pages stand in for an IC-style absolute maximum table. Nonpolar components need no electrical pin assignment.
conventions.source_revision: Electrical revision, package-appendix revisions and PDF metadata can differ. Exact local bytes are identified by SHA-256; remote-only entries have null SHA-256. Unversioned sheets use printed dates or explicitly labeled PDF metadata dates.
conventions.family_datasheets: One identical family PDF is saved under each applicable exact schematic MPN. Family coverage is not a parts-availability or qualification check.
conventions.pdf_git_policy: PDFs remain local and uncommitted. Only DATASHEET_REGISTER.md and DATASHEET_REGISTER.json are committed. The repository currently does not ignore third_party/datasheets; use explicit file staging.
